name: rea-desktop
description: Use REA's local MCP server to reverse engineer applications, websites, JavaScript/Electron projects, managed assemblies, firmware, and native binaries.
long_description: An unofficial community-packaged Claude Desktop Extension for the REA MCP server. It launches the official rea-agents 6.8.0 npm package over stdio. REA exposes tools for application behavior tracing, JavaScript analysis, binary inspection, evidence capture, and reconstruction verification. Upstream REA project and copyright remain with morluto.
